extDescription.message: Translate selected text and typed text on-device with Chrome's built-in Translator API.

copyFailed.message: Could not access the clipboard. Select the text and copy it manually.

statusDownloadable.message: This language pair needs a one-time model download by Chrome. It starts when you translate.

statusDownloading.message: Chrome is downloading the language model… $PCT$%

statusUnsupported.message: This browser does not support Chrome's built-in Translator API. Use a recent desktop version of Chrome (138 or later).

statusUnsupportedInPage.message: Translation is not available on this page. Try the extension popup instead.

statusPairUnavailable.message: Chrome cannot translate between these languages. Choose a different pair.

statusSameLanguage.message: The text is already in the target language.

errorDetectFailed.message: Could not detect the language. Choose the source language manually.

errorOffline.message: You appear to be offline. Chrome needs a connection to download this language model.

errorNeedsGesture.message: Click Translate again to allow Chrome to download the model.

errorDownload.message: The language model could not be downloaded. Check your connection and free disk space, then try again.

errorTooLong.message: The text exceeds the $MAX$-character limit. Select or paste a shorter fragment.

errorGeneric.message: Something went wrong while translating. Please try again.

privacyNote.message: Text is translated on your device. Chrome may download AI language models on demand; your text is never sent with that download.
